bio.text: Adam Bauman is the Republican candidate for Texas's 16th Congressional District in 2026, projected by the Associated Press to have won the May primary runoff; he faces Democratic nominee Veronica Escobar.

According to Ballotpedia, Adam Bauman served in the U.S. Navy as a Special Warfare Combatant Crewman, and his career experience includes working with the U.S. Border Patrol as a member of the Border Patrol Tactical Team.
